text_block_list.text:
The Sumire Stakes is an open race, so
the racers
are ranked slightly lower when
compared to
graded races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I feel like Супер Крик can conquer it if
she gives
it all she's got, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothing! I think I'm still just a
little tired
from yesterday.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's been happening from time to time
lately. But
it's really nothing to worry
about.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
More importantly, before the race
starts... would
you care to have a boxed
lunch with me in the
central plaza?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I... made us some sweet omelets... and

octopus-shaped wien—
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Okay, sorry. I'll lie down for a bit...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик appears to be feeling a
little better
after her nap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thank you. I think I'm good now...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Do you want to withdraw from the race?

text_block_list.text: No, anything but that! I can run—really.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's a shame that I didn't get to see the
sumire
violets with you...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But I'll try to make up for it with a
beautiful result
in this race.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
